simple.meaning: Maakah (or Maakath), the name of a place in Syria, also of a Mesopotamian, of three Israelites, and of four Israelitesses and one Syrian woman
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַעֲכָה (H4601) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 23 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
